title: Home-field advantage raised from 2.5 to 3.0 points
why: Week 8's picks leaned heavily toward road teams, and home teams went 23-14 against the spread. A check of 2023-2026 found the projections underrated home teams slightly at 2.5 points; at 3.0 that bias goes away.
effect: Small. In the 2023-2026 backtest, ESPN FPI's picks at the opening line went from 53.3% to 54.0%, and every projection moved by less than one percentage point. Market-anchored was retrained and barely changed.
forward_test: Picks already in the forward-test log were made with 2.5 and are not changed. Picks logged from October 25, 2026 on use 3.0.
